name: MiniSprint
summary:
A new era of casual gaming at your fingertips.

Built for Meta VR glasses, your real world becomes the racetrack. A whole racing arcade experience that fits your space. Position it wherever you want, at the perfect size for your view. Tiny cars, detailed miniature streets, right in the room with you.
